summary: Senior Platform Engineer with 5+ years building scalable backend systems, microservices, and cloud infrastructure on AWS. Expert in Node.js, event-driven architecture, CI/CD, and cost-optimized platform engineering.

bullets.title: Platform Scalability
bullets.body: Scaled Edmingle from thousands to over 30M+ records using microservices, optimized MySQL queries, and event-driven architecture. Improved system performance by 65%, enabling real-time analytics and boosting revenue by 15%.

bullets.title: High Availability & Reliability
bullets.body: Achieved 99.99% uptime through multi-AZ failovers, load-balanced services, and real-time monitoring. Ensured zero-downtime deployments and smooth scaling during academic peaks.

bullets.title: Cost Optimization
bullets.body: Migrated notification services from Mailgun to Amazon SES, cutting email costs by 70% while improving deliverability. Deployed serverless functions and auto-scaling EC2, reducing idle compute costs by 40%.

bullets.title: Smart Calendar & Scheduling
bullets.body: Built an interactive calendar and class scheduling module with 300ms API response times. Adopted by 40% of platform users, improving scheduling efficiency and user engagement.

bullets.title: Secure Payment Architecture
bullets.body: Revamped multi-gateway payment integrations (Razorpay, Stripe, PayU) into a modular marketplace model, reducing integration time from 2 weeks to 3 days with full webhook verification.

bullets.title: Resilient Webhook Framework
bullets.body: Designed a secure webhook system with event deduplication, signature validation, and retries for real-time external integrations.

bullets.title: SDK & SSO Integration
bullets.body: Developed the official Edmingle SDK and integrated Single Sign-On, enhancing white-label capabilities and simplifying client onboarding.

bullets.title: Deployment Automation
bullets.body: Engineered CI/CD and deployment automation via Jenkins and Docker, reducing release times by 2x and improving reliability across environments.

bullets.title: Inventory Management & POS
